scope:
Package K2b-3 (KERNEL, SMALL bug fix, about 30 tool calls; no web, no new action). BUG (found by S2's android-smoke on the emulator, run 39865097050, same on 3 profiles): in the interview conversation a remark such as 'nie pytaj o zdrowie' is NOT understood when no question is waiting. S1's reading of the code (verify, do not trust): loom/src/actions/profile_ops.cpp Result<Reply> op_answer (line ~363): when args has no `slot`, it takes the next question from plan()/next_of(); if there is none (every question at the level asked, or the section skipped with 'skip' - S2's path was level 'minimal' -> 'skip' -> 'nie pytaj o zdrowie') it returns err(InvalidArgument, profile_no_slot = 'Którego pola dotyczy? Podaj pole albo kategorię.') BEFORE the remark is read (the remark view `view(e,l,{what:'remark',...})` is ~10 lines further down). The route (loom/src/actions/route.cpp interview_turn, ~line 3019) then posts that error text as an assistant message, so the person sees a wrong question instead of 'Tak zrozumialem ...' + Tak/Nie. The owner's rule: the person can say 'do not ask about X' at ANY moment; a remark never depends on a pending question; nothing is hidden silently. The same would be true for the control words? (no: control_op() is resolved earlier in `interview()` and is fine - check).
DO: (1) REPRODUCE FIRST with a failing doctest in loom/tests/test_profile_ops.cpp (or test_profile_chat.cpp, whichever has the conversation-level helpers; reuse them): (a) level 'minimal' chosen, then the section skipped, then the text 'nie pytaj o zdrowie' sent through the conversation (the route) -> must give a pending proposal (action profile.confirm, kind remark), nothing written before the yes; (b) every question at the level answered (loop answers until data.done is true), then the same remark -> proposal; after the yes the category is `never` and plan() no longer lists it (reuse an existing assertion style); (c) a text that is NOT a remark and not a control word, with no question waiting -> a plain assistant message in words (see 3), no error text, nothing written; (d) with a question waiting the behaviour is byte-identical to today (existing tests stay green). Paste the failing assertions of (a) and (b) on the old code. (2) FIX op_answer: read the remark FIRST (only needs text and level), and only if it does not match resolve the slot / fail. Keep the existing order of everything else. ASAN DISCIPLINE (two ASan-only classes bit us, CI is the only place that proves them): never range-for over .at()/.value()/operator[] of a by-value temporary; NEVER hold a pointer or reference into a Json/state object (l.state, a field) across a call that can assign to it (write(), set_setting, a setter) - copy first (field_of already returns std::optional<Json>). Read your own diff once with exactly those two questions. (3) WORDS: when the text is not a remark and no question is waiting, the answer must tell the truth in plain Polish/English as DATA in loom/data/runtime/chat_ops.pack profile words (pl+en; e.g. 'Teraz nie czekam na Twoją odpowiedź. Napisz „nie pytaj o …”, „pytaj więcej” albo „podsumowanie”.' - verify that every sentence you promise (e.g. 'pytaj więcej') really is understood by the remark rules / control words in scenario.pack and chat_ops.pack today; promise only what works). Use a NEW key (e.g. profile_nothing_waiting) instead of changing profile_no_slot, which is still right for the direct action call profile.interview {op:answer} without slot over the API. K2b-2 style: no snake_case, dotted ids, true/false, '=' in the visible strings - the data-driven words test over the profile words must cover the new key (extend it if it enumerates keys by hand). Where the answer is built: either op_answer returns a Reply (ok, written=false, data.question=null) instead of err, or the route maps the error - choose the smaller change that keeps the direct API honest (an error for a missing slot over the API is fine). (4) Regenerate runtime_profiles_embedded.inc (python3 loom/src/model/gen_runtime_profiles.py, then --check). If chat_ops.pack changes, any pinned sha256 for it in loom/data/data_domains.pack must be re-pinned (ctest -R 'kb_pack|kb_data_domains|runtime_profile' will tell). (5) Record the decision and how to reverse it under 'S1 / M1-K2b3' in docs/reports/INDEX.md (short). Do NOT touch loom/android/smoke/*, loom/web, the golden chat_request_legacy.json, the receipt schema. The branch claude/m1-w0 is at 5d4744c2 (K2c-1 finished and pushed; the tree is clean); if `git status` is not clean or HEAD is not 5d4744c2 or later, stop and say so.
